<module id="parallel2serial">
    <description>Parallel to Serial Converter</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="d" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit parallel input data.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Valid output flag.</output>
        <output id="dout">Serial output data.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description></parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <output id="valid_out" width_description="">Combination of valid signal and counter value.</output>
        <output id="dout" width_description="">Most significant bit of parallel data.</output>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Sequential logic for updating data register, counter, and valid signal.</implementation>
    <task>
        <title>Task 1: Parallel to Serial Conversion</title>
        <description>Design a parallel to serial converter where every 4 bits of parallel input are converted to a serial output bit (MSB to LSB). The valid_out signal should be set to 1 to indicate the availability of a valid serial output. When valid_out = 1, the MSB of d is output, and the remaining bits are output sequentially in the next 3 cycles.</description>
    </task>
</module>
```

module parallel2serial (
    // Inputs and Outputs defined in the order specified in the XML file
    input           clk,
    input           rst_n,
    input   [3:0]   d,
    output          valid_out,
    output          dout
);
reg     [3:0]   data;
reg             valid;
reg     [1:0]   cnt;
always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (~rst_n) begin
        cnt <= 'd0;
        valid <= 1'd0;
        data <= 4'd0;
    end else begin
        if (cnt == 2'd3) begin
            data <= d;
            cnt <= 2'd0;
            valid <= 1'd1;
        end else begin
            cnt <= cnt + 2'd1;
            valid <= 1'd0;
